terms.title: Solana
terms.summary: A high-performance layer-1 blockchain that uses Proof of History and parallel transaction processing.
terms.definition: Solana achieves low-latency finality through a combination of Proof of History and a Tower BFT consensus. Its ecosystem of DeFi, NFT, and consumer apps provides comparative data points for cross-chain liquidity strategies.

terms.title: Solomon Islands
terms.summary: A Pacific Island nation partnering with SORAMITSU to pilot Bokolo Cash and explore SORA-powered financial infrastructure.
terms.definition: The Solomon Islands collaborate with SORAMITSU on Bokolo Cash and broader digital financial services. The partnership showcases how SORA technology can deliver CBDCs, merchant tools, and cross-border remittances for emerging markets with limited legacy banking infrastructure.

terms.title: SORA
terms.summary: SORA is a decentralized economic network featuring XOR elastic supply tokenomics, Polkaswap DEX, HASHI cross-chain bridge, and democratic governance through SORA Parliament. The network is transitioning from Substrate (SORA v2) to Hyperledger Iroha 3 (SORA v3/Nexus).
terms.definition: SORA is a decentralized economic network featuring XOR elastic supply tokenomics, Polkaswap DEX, HASHI cross-chain bridge, and democratic governance through SORA Parliament. The network is transitioning from Substrate (SORA v2) to Hyperledger Iroha 3 (SORA v3/Nexus).
terms.tagline: Foundation for a new decentralized world economy with programmable finance and democratic governance.

terms.title: SORA Card
terms.summary: A decentralized debit card that allows users to spend their cryptocurrency in the real world. The SORA Card bridges the gap between digital assets and traditional commerce, enab…
terms.definition: A decentralized debit card that allows users to spend their cryptocurrency in the real world. The SORA Card bridges the gap between digital assets and traditional commerce, enabling users to make purchases at any merchant that accepts card payments while maintaining the benefits of decentralized finance.
terms.tagline: Bridges crypto and traditional payments for everyday spending.

terms.title: Soracles
terms.summary: Deterministic oracle actors in SORA Nexus governed like data spaces, with onboarding requirements, rate limits, and proof budgets that bring off-chain data on-chain securely.
terms.definition: Deterministic oracle actors in SORA Nexus governed like data spaces, with onboarding requirements, rate limits, and proof budgets that bring off-chain data on-chain securely.
terms.tagline: Brings off-chain data on-chain with the same security guarantees as native transactions.

terms.title: SORA Council
terms.summary: A governance body in SORA's current Polkadot v1 governance system that consists of elected members who can propose referenda and veto dangerous proposals. The council plays a ke…
terms.definition: A governance body in SORA's current Polkadot v1 governance system that consists of elected members who can propose referenda and veto dangerous proposals. The council plays a key role in the governance process before transitioning to the SORA Parliament.

terms.title: SORA Ecosystem
terms.summary: The SORA Ecosystem encompasses all applications, protocols, and communities built on or integrated with the SORA network, including Polkaswap, Fearless Wallet, TONSwap, CBDC implementations, and governance infrastructure.
terms.definition: The SORA Ecosystem encompasses all applications, protocols, and communities built on or integrated with the SORA network, including Polkaswap, Fearless Wallet, TONSwap, CBDC implementations, and governance infrastructure.

terms.title: SoraFS
terms.summary: The decentralized storage and erasure-coding layer in SORA Nexus that handles lane envelopes, DA proofs, and retry policies for resilient data persistence across validators.
terms.definition: The decentralized storage and erasure-coding layer in SORA Nexus that handles lane envelopes, DA proofs, and retry policies for resilient data persistence across validators.
terms.tagline: Enables parallel transaction processing for higher throughput.

terms.title: Soramitsu
terms.summary: A Japanese fintech company that develops blockchain infrastructure and digital identity solutions. SORAMITSU is the company behind the SORA network and has implemented successfu…
terms.definition: A Japanese fintech company that develops blockchain infrastructure and digital identity solutions. SORAMITSU is the company behind the SORA network and has implemented successful CBDC projects including Cambodia's Bakong and Lao CBDC pilot.

terms.title: SoraNet
terms.summary: The privacy overlay and deterministic CDN using three-hop QUIC circuits, hybrid PQ handshakes, and blinded metadata for data delivery.
terms.definition: The privacy overlay and deterministic CDN using three-hop QUIC circuits, hybrid PQ handshakes, and blinded metadata for data delivery.
terms.tagline: Protects user privacy while delivering content with predictable latency.

terms.title: SORA Network
terms.summary: SORA Network is the decentralized blockchain infrastructure powering XOR, Polkaswap, and the broader SORA ecosystem. It provides programmable finance, democratic governance, and interoperability with multiple chains.
terms.definition: SORA Network is the decentralized blockchain infrastructure powering XOR, Polkaswap, and the broader SORA ecosystem. It provides programmable finance, democratic governance, and interoperability with multiple chains.

terms.title: SORA Nexus
terms.summary: The single logical ledger built on Hyperledger Iroha 3 that unifies private data spaces, public domains, and modern cryptography.
terms.definition: The single logical ledger built on Hyperledger Iroha 3 that unifies private data spaces, public domains, and modern cryptography.
terms.tagline: Unified ledger on Iroha 3 for public domains and private data spaces.

terms.title: SORA Parliament
terms.summary: The future democratic governance system of SORA using multi-body sortition with clear separation of powers. The SORA Parliament will replace the current Governance V1 system, im…
terms.definition: The future democratic governance system of SORA using multi-body sortition with clear separation of powers. The SORA Parliament will replace the current Governance V1 system, implementing sortition-based democracy where citizens are randomly selected (not token voting) and must post XOR bonds for citizenship. Features multiple bodies: Rules Committee, Agenda Council, Interest Panels, Review Panel, and Policy Jury. Main task is allocating newly minted XOR to productive projects. In SORA v3, the Parliament will integrate with a hybrid DAO framework using Iroha Special Instructions (ISIs) for modular governance logic.
terms.tagline: Gives the community direct control over network upgrades and treasury spending.

terms.title: Sora Profile
terms.summary: Irohad feature profile enabled via `--sora` or `IROHA_SORA_PROFILE`, applying Sora Nexus defaults and requiring the flag when Sora-only config overrides (SoraFS, multi-lane routing) are present.
terms.definition: Irohad feature profile enabled via `--sora` or `IROHA_SORA_PROFILE`, applying Sora Nexus defaults and requiring the flag when Sora-only config overrides (SoraFS, multi-lane routing) are present.
terms.tagline: Turns on Sora Nexus features and guards against misconfiguration.

terms.title: SORA v2
terms.summary: The current version of the SORA network built on Substrate framework as a Polkadot parachain. SORA v2 provides DeFi services, cross-chain functionality, and serves as the founda…
terms.definition: The current version of the SORA network built on Substrate framework as a Polkadot parachain. SORA v2 provides DeFi services, cross-chain functionality, and serves as the foundation for the upcoming SORA v3 migration to Hyperledger Iroha.

terms.title: SORA v3
terms.summary: SORA v3, also known as SORA Nexus, is the next generation of the SORA network. It transitions from Substrate-based SORA v2 to Hyperledger Iroha 3, introducing a modular, high-pe…
terms.definition: SORA v3, also known as SORA Nexus, is the next generation of the SORA network. It transitions from Substrate-based SORA v2 to Hyperledger Iroha 3, introducing a modular, high-performance design to support scalability and cross-chain interoperability. The SORA v3 Hub Chain (or Hubchain) enables seamless collaboration between permissioned and decentralized systems, designed for CBDCs, government integration, and economic sovereignty while maintaining borderless financial activities. It serves as a supranational platform that de-correlates CBDCs and government-issued digital assets from political and economic instability, providing a stable foundation for global transactions.

terms.title: Sortition
terms.summary: A governance mechanism where participants are randomly selected to make decisions, rather than through voting or token holdings. The SORA Parliament uses sortition as one of its…
terms.definition: A governance mechanism where participants are randomly selected to make decisions, rather than through voting or token holdings. The SORA Parliament uses sortition as one of its core principles, randomly choosing citizens to participate in governance bodies, ensuring fair representation and preventing plutocracy.

terms.title: Soshiba
terms.summary: A community-launched meme token within the SORA ecosystem that experiments with gamified engagement and education.
terms.definition: SOSHIBA was introduced to test lightweight incentive campaigns for the SORA community, including airdrops, social quests, and liquidity rewards. It provides a low-stakes environment for exploring meme-driven outreach while keeping treasury resources separate from core network assets.

terms.title: Sovereign Data Spaces
terms.summary: Data spaces that let entities maintain jurisdictional control over privacy, routing, and compliance while sharing the global ledger.
terms.definition: Data spaces that let entities maintain jurisdictional control over privacy, routing, and compliance while sharing the global ledger.
terms.tagline: Let entities maintain jurisdictional control over privacy.

terms.title: SoraNet Relay Certificate (SRCv2)
terms.summary: Directory-published CBOR certificate describing a SoraNet relay (identity keys, endpoints, capabilities, validity window, and PQ KEM policy), signed with Ed25519 and ML-DSA-65 for hybrid security.
terms.definition: Directory-published CBOR certificate describing a SoraNet relay (identity keys, endpoints, capabilities, validity window, and PQ KEM policy), signed with Ed25519 and ML-DSA-65 for hybrid security.
terms.tagline: How relays prove identity and advertise capabilities to the directory.

terms.title: Stable Asset
terms.summary: A stable asset is any token designed to maintain a consistent value, typically pegged to fiat currency. KUSD is SORA primary stable asset, backed by over-collateralized vaults and stability mechanisms.
terms.definition: A stable asset is any token designed to maintain a consistent value, typically pegged to fiat currency. KUSD is SORA primary stable asset, backed by over-collateralized vaults and stability mechanisms.

terms.title: Stablecoin
terms.summary: A stablecoin is a digital asset engineered to hold a predictable value, such as KUSD or future SORA settlement tokens used for payments.
terms.definition: A stablecoin is a digital asset engineered to hold a predictable value, such as KUSD or future SORA settlement tokens used for payments.
terms.tagline: Enables everyday transactions without price volatility.

terms.title: Staking
terms.summary: The process of locking tokens to support network security and earn rewards. SORA users can stake XOR tokens to validators and receive staking rewards.
terms.definition: The process of locking tokens to support network security and earn rewards. SORA users can stake XOR tokens to validators and receive staking rewards.

terms.title: Stark
terms.summary: The transparent proof system underpinning FASTPQ in SORA Nexus, providing post-quantum security and succinct verification without requiring a trusted setup ceremony.
terms.definition: The transparent proof system underpinning FASTPQ in SORA Nexus, providing post-quantum security and succinct verification without requiring a trusted setup ceremony.
terms.tagline: Enhances network security and protects user data.

terms.title: STARK Security Budget
terms.summary: The parameter sizing in SORA Nexus controlling blow-up factors, query counts, and grinding that keeps FASTPQ proofs at 128-bit or higher cryptographic soundness.
terms.definition: The parameter sizing in SORA Nexus controlling blow-up factors, query counts, and grinding that keeps FASTPQ proofs at 128-bit or higher cryptographic soundness.
terms.tagline: Ensures fair resource allocation across the network.

terms.title: Start-Time Fair Queuing (SFQ)
terms.summary: Start-Time Fair Queuing, the scheduler that orders work by virtual finish times while enforcing TEU and age constraints.
terms.definition: Start-Time Fair Queuing, the scheduler that orders work by virtual finish times while enforcing TEU and age constraints.
terms.tagline: Orders work by virtual finish times while enforcing TEU and age constraints.

terms.title: State Application
terms.summary: The deterministic process in SORA Nexus of applying validated instructions to the World State View after consensus confirms a block, updating balances and metadata.
terms.definition: The deterministic process in SORA Nexus of applying validated instructions to the World State View after consensus confirms a block, updating balances and metadata.
terms.tagline: Essential component of the SORA Nexus architecture.

terms.title: State Root
terms.summary: A cryptographic commitment (hash) to the post-block ledger state, used by consensus and light clients to verify that all nodes reached the same result.
terms.definition: A cryptographic commitment (hash) to the post-block ledger state, used by consensus and light clients to verify that all nodes reached the same result.
terms.tagline: Commits to the ledger state so it can be verified without downloading everything.

terms.title: Submission
terms.summary: The first step of the transaction lifecycle in SORA Nexus where signed Norito instructions enter the network through gateways and proceed to admission and scheduling.
terms.definition: The first step of the transaction lifecycle in SORA Nexus where signed Norito instructions enter the network through gateways and proceed to admission and scheduling.
terms.tagline: Provides seamless access to SORA Nexus services.

terms.title: Substrate
terms.summary: A modular blockchain framework developed by Parity Technologies. SORA v2 uses Substrate as its foundation to integrate with the Polkadot ecosystem and enable cross-chain functio…
terms.definition: A modular blockchain framework developed by Parity Technologies. SORA v2 uses Substrate as its foundation to integrate with the Polkadot ecosystem and enable cross-chain functionality through parachain connectivity. SORA v3 (Nexus) is migrating away from Substrate to Hyperledger Iroha 3 for improved efficiency, enterprise integration, and enhanced capabilities for CBDC and government use cases.

terms.title: Sumeragi
terms.summary: The BFT consensus protocol at the heart of SORA Nexus featuring deterministic leader rotation, cryptographic locking rules, and sub-second finality for all transactions.
terms.definition: The BFT consensus protocol at the heart of SORA Nexus featuring deterministic leader rotation, cryptographic locking rules, and sub-second finality for all transactions.
terms.tagline: Delivers sub-second block finality while tolerating up to one-third Byzantine validators.

terms.title: Sumeragi Consensus
terms.summary: The formal HotStuff-style guarantees in SORA Nexus—safety, liveness, and QC intersection—embedded in the SUMERAGI pipeline to ensure consistent block finalization.
terms.definition: The formal HotStuff-style guarantees in SORA Nexus—safety, liveness, and QC intersection—embedded in the SUMERAGI pipeline to ensure consistent block finalization.
terms.tagline: Provides mathematical proof that committed blocks cannot be reverted, even under network partitions.

terms.title: SUMERAGI Pipeline
terms.summary: The multi-stage HotStuff-like consensus process in SORA Nexus that sequences proposals, votes, and commits per lane, achieving sub-second finality with Byzantine fault tolerance.
terms.definition: The multi-stage HotStuff-like consensus process in SORA Nexus that sequences proposals, votes, and commits per lane, achieving sub-second finality with Byzantine fault tolerance.
terms.tagline: Enables parallel transaction processing for higher throughput.

terms.title: Supply Management
terms.summary: Supply management encompasses all mechanisms controlling token issuance, burning, and circulation. SORA uses the Token Bonding Curve, fee burns, and strategic reserves to maintain healthy token economics.
terms.definition: Supply management encompasses all mechanisms controlling token issuance, burning, and circulation. SORA uses the Token Bonding Curve, fee burns, and strategic reserves to maintain healthy token economics.

terms.title: Supply Reduction
terms.summary: Supply reduction refers to mechanisms that decrease the circulating supply of tokens over time, including burns, lockups, and deflationary tokenomics. SORA implements supply reduction through transaction fee burns and buyback programs.
terms.definition: Supply reduction refers to mechanisms that decrease the circulating supply of tokens over time, including burns, lockups, and deflationary tokenomics. SORA implements supply reduction through transaction fee burns and buyback programs.

terms.title: Supranational Platform
terms.summary: A blockchain platform that operates above the level of individual nation states, enabling global coordination and collaboration without being subject to any single country's jur…
terms.definition: A blockchain platform that operates above the level of individual nation states, enabling global coordination and collaboration without being subject to any single country's jurisdiction. SORA v3 serves as a supranational platform that de-correlates CBDCs and government-issued digital assets from political and economic instability, providing a stable foundation for global transactions. This design enables nations, institutions, and individuals to create assets and conduct transactions on a borderless, decentralized infrastructure.

terms.title: Syscalls
terms.summary: Limited, 8-bit-indexed entry points exposed by the IVM for operations like hashing or storage, each with deterministic gas cost.
terms.definition: Limited, 8-bit-indexed entry points exposed by the IVM for operations like hashing or storage, each with deterministic gas cost.
terms.tagline: Provides a secure, auditable interface between smart contracts and the underlying runtime.

terms.title: Taikai
terms.summary: The streaming and data pipeline platform in SORA Nexus governed on-ledger, supporting Norito streaming, real-time telemetry, and cryptographic slashing for validator misbehavior.
terms.definition: The streaming and data pipeline platform in SORA Nexus governed on-ledger, supporting Norito streaming, real-time telemetry, and cryptographic slashing for validator misbehavior.
terms.tagline: Detects and penalizes validator misbehavior through on-ledger governance, protecting network integrity while enabling real-time data streaming.

terms.title: TBCD
terms.summary: Token Bonding Curve Dollar (TBCD) is an algorithmic, non-synthetic stablecoin whose value is maintained by the SORA token bonding curve at approximately $1 USD. TBCD is converti…
terms.definition: Token Bonding Curve Dollar (TBCD) is an algorithmic, non-synthetic stablecoin whose value is maintained by the SORA token bonding curve at approximately $1 USD. TBCD is convertible to XOR as a reserve asset of the token bonding curve and helps build up reserves while also being used to fund the creation of new goods and services via on-chain governance. In SORA v3 tokenomics, 0.5% of all network transaction fees are allocated for buyback and burning of TBCD. TBCD can only be created and allocated by on-chain governance, meaning XOR token holders decide the supply.
terms.tagline: Offers algorithmic stability through the token bonding curve mechanism.

terms.title: Telegram
terms.summary: Telegram is the primary chat channel where the SORA community coordinates releases, support, validator updates, and governance calls.
terms.definition: Telegram is the primary chat channel where the SORA community coordinates releases, support, validator updates, and governance calls.
terms.tagline: Central hub for community coordination and support.

terms.title: Telemetry
terms.summary: The observability feeds in SORA Nexus—lane latency, DA failures, circuit breaker status—that operators monitor to maintain network health and respond to issues quickly.
terms.definition: The observability feeds in SORA Nexus—lane latency, DA failures, circuit breaker status—that operators monitor to maintain network health and respond to issues quickly.
terms.tagline: Enables parallel transaction processing for higher throughput.

terms.title: Three-Hop QUIC Circuits
terms.summary: SORA Nexus's onion-style routing pattern using QUIC protocol, providing low-latency privacy with fixed three-hop paths that hide user IP addresses from destination servers.
terms.definition: SORA Nexus's onion-style routing pattern using QUIC protocol, providing low-latency privacy with fixed three-hop paths that hide user IP addresses from destination servers.
terms.tagline: Hides user IP addresses from destination servers while maintaining fast connections.

terms.title: Token Bonding Curve
terms.summary: A smart contract that manages the supply of XOR in a rational way without human involvement. The TBC automatically adjusts XOR supply based on economic conditions to maintain pr…
terms.definition: A smart contract that manages the supply of XOR in a rational way without human involvement. The TBC automatically adjusts XOR supply based on economic conditions to maintain price stability, expanding supply during growth and contracting during decline.
terms.tagline: Creates predictable pricing and built-in liquidity for XOR without requiring external market makers.

terms.title: Token Burning
terms.summary: The permanent removal of tokens from circulation by sending them to an unrecoverable address. In SORA, token burning is used as a deflationary mechanism - VAL tokens are burned …
terms.definition: The permanent removal of tokens from circulation by sending them to an unrecoverable address. In SORA, token burning is used as a deflationary mechanism - VAL tokens are burned on every network transaction, and PSWAP tokens are burned on every Polkaswap transaction to reduce supply over time.

terms.title: Tokenization
terms.summary: The conversion of rights to an asset into a digital token on a blockchain. Tokenization underpins SORA's strategy of turning real-world economic activity into programmable, composable assets.
terms.definition: Tokenization abstracts ownership or utility into blockchain-based tokens that can be traded, fractionally owned, or used as collateral. It is a foundational capability for SORA's knowledge base, enabling CBDCs, RWAs, and incentive programs to interoperate within the Polkaswap ecosystem.

terms.title: Tokenized Assets
terms.summary: A use case where real-world assets are issued in data spaces with deterministic policy, proofs, and ISO-aligned connectors.
terms.definition: A use case where real-world assets are issued in data spaces with deterministic policy, proofs, and ISO-aligned connectors.
terms.tagline: Essential component of the SORA Nexus architecture.

terms.title: Tokenomics
terms.summary: Tokenomics explores supply design, burn models, and incentive loops that guide SORA’s economic roadmap.
terms.definition: Tokenomics explores supply design, burn models, and incentive loops that guide SORA’s economic roadmap.
terms.tagline: Creates sustainable value through aligned incentives.

terms.title: Token Repackaging
terms.summary: An initiative in the SORA roadmap to migrate legacy assets into a simplified portfolio of utility, reward, and stable tokens that align with the SORA v3 economic model.
terms.definition: Token repackaging consolidates historical SORA and Polkaswap assets into a streamlined set of instruments—XOR for settlement, VAL for validator rewards, PSWAP for liquidity incentives, and new stable instruments such as TBCD. The program retires illiquid or redundant tokens, migrates balances, and funds ecosystem development through governance-approved conversions.

terms.title: TON
terms.summary: TON (The Open Network) is a Telegram-backed blockchain known for high throughput and mobile-native UX that now powers TONSwap's SORA-linked DeFi.
terms.definition: TON (The Open Network) is a Telegram-backed blockchain known for high throughput and mobile-native UX that now powers TONSwap's SORA-linked DeFi.
terms.tagline: Opens SORA to Telegram massive user base.

terms.title: TONSWAP
terms.summary: A next-generation decentralized exchange (DEX) and launchpad built on The Open Network (TON) blockchain. TONSWAP combines cutting-edge concentrated liquidity technology with a u…
terms.definition: A next-generation decentralized exchange (DEX) and launchpad built on The Open Network (TON) blockchain. TONSWAP combines cutting-edge concentrated liquidity technology with a user-friendly design, offering ultra-fast trades, near-zero fees, and seamless Telegram integration. It serves as a TON-native gateway for mobile-first DeFi access. TONSWAP creates sustained on-chain demand for XOR tokens by automatically allocating 10% of all trading fees to buy back and burn XOR, connecting TON ecosystem activity to the SORA economy.
terms.tagline: Expands SORA DeFi reach to Telegram users through TON integration.

terms.title: Torii
terms.summary: The Norito-native gateway in SORA Nexus that streams events, receipts, and telemetry to clients via REST, SSE, or gRPC, providing real-time updates without polling.
terms.definition: The Norito-native gateway in SORA Nexus that streams events, receipts, and telemetry to clients via REST, SSE, or gRPC, providing real-time updates without polling.
terms.tagline: Provides real-time updates to applications without polling.

terms.title: Trading
terms.summary: Trading on SORA encompasses swapping tokens on Polkaswap, providing liquidity to pools, and participating in price discovery through the DEX. The network supports multiple liquidity sources and algorithmic pricing for efficient markets.
terms.definition: Trading on SORA encompasses swapping tokens on Polkaswap, providing liquidity to pools, and participating in price discovery through the DEX. The network supports multiple liquidity sources and algorithmic pricing for efficient markets.

terms.title: Trading Fees
terms.summary: Charges applied to trading transactions on decentralized exchanges. In SORA, trading fees on Polkaswap are used for various purposes including PSWAP buyback-and-burn (0.3%), val…
terms.definition: Charges applied to trading transactions on decentralized exchanges. In SORA, trading fees on Polkaswap are used for various purposes including PSWAP buyback-and-burn (0.3%), validator rewards, and network maintenance.

terms.title: Trading Strategy
terms.summary: A framework for entering and exiting markets to achieve risk-adjusted returns. Polkaswap traders use strategies to balance liquidity mining, arbitrage, and long-term positioning.
terms.definition: Trading strategies outline rules for portfolio allocation, order placement, and risk management. In SORA, strategies can combine Polkaswap swaps, liquidity provision, and staking to capture yield while supporting ecosystem liquidity.

terms.title: Transaction Execution Units (TEU)
terms.summary: The Transaction Execution Unit in SORA Nexus measuring instruction cost, bandwidth, and storage consumption to drive fair scheduling and predictable fee calculation.
terms.definition: The Transaction Execution Unit in SORA Nexus measuring instruction cost, bandwidth, and storage consumption to drive fair scheduling and predictable fee calculation.
terms.tagline: Lets users predict transaction costs before submitting, preventing surprise fees.

terms.title: Transaction Lifecycle
terms.summary: The six-stage flow - submission, admission, execution, aggregation, consensus, exposure - that every Nexus transaction follows.
terms.definition: The six-stage flow - submission, admission, execution, aggregation, consensus, exposure - that every Nexus transaction follows.
terms.tagline: Every Nexus transaction follows.

terms.title: Triggers
terms.summary: On-ledger automation objects in SORA Nexus with condition, action, and budget fields that execute scheduled tasks or event reactions without requiring external cron jobs or keepers.
terms.definition: On-ledger automation objects in SORA Nexus with condition, action, and budget fields that execute scheduled tasks or event reactions without requiring external cron jobs or keepers.
terms.tagline: Enables smart contracts to self-execute based on time or events, removing reliance on external keepers.

terms.title: Ts
terms.summary: The platform token for TONSWAP, a decentralized exchange and launchpad on The Open Network (TON).
terms.definition: TS grants governance rights and distributes incentives on TONSWAP, the TON-based DEX that integrates with SORA liquidity programs. Holders can participate in fee distribution and vote on protocol upgrades that affect listings and incentive schedules.

terms.title: Two-Dimensional Erasure Coding
terms.summary: The matrix-style Reed - Solomon scheme (rows and columns) SoraFS uses to ensure any subset of shards can rebuild the original data.
terms.definition: The matrix-style Reed - Solomon scheme (rows and columns) SoraFS uses to ensure any subset of shards can rebuild the original data.
terms.tagline: Essential component of the SORA Nexus architecture.

terms.title: Uaid
terms.summary: Short for UniversalAccountId; a hash-based universal account identifier (rendered `uaid:<hex>`) used as a stable capability anchor across Nexus dataspaces and lanes, including Space Directory manifests keyed by UAID + DataSpaceId.
terms.definition: Short for UniversalAccountId; a hash-based universal account identifier (rendered `uaid:<hex>`) used as a stable capability anchor across Nexus dataspaces and lanes, including Space Directory manifests keyed by UAID + DataSpaceId.
terms.tagline: A universal account anchor shared across data spaces.

terms.title: VAL
terms.summary: A validator reward token for the SORA network used to reward validators and stake nominators. VAL has deflationary tokenomics with tokens burned on every transaction, and elasti…
terms.definition: A validator reward token for the SORA network used to reward validators and stake nominators. VAL has deflationary tokenomics with tokens burned on every transaction, and elastic rewards distributed as a percentage of daily burned tokens.
terms.tagline: Incentivizes network security through deflationary rewards to validators and nominators.

terms.title: Validator
terms.summary: A network participant that validates transactions and maintains the blockchain. Validators in SORA secure the network and earn rewards for their services.
terms.definition: A network participant that validates transactions and maintains the blockchain. Validators in SORA secure the network and earn rewards for their services.

terms.title: Validators
terms.summary: Validators are network operators who stake tokens to produce blocks, validate transactions, and maintain consensus. SORA validators earn VAL rewards for securing the network and processing state transitions.
terms.definition: Validators are network operators who stake tokens to produce blocks, validate transactions, and maintain consensus. SORA validators earn VAL rewards for securing the network and processing state transitions.

terms.title: Vault
terms.summary: A vault is a smart contract that securely holds collateral for minting synthetic assets or stablecoins. On SORA, Kensetsu vaults allow users to deposit XOR, VAL, or other assets to borrow KUSD.
terms.definition: A vault is a smart contract that securely holds collateral for minting synthetic assets or stablecoins. On SORA, Kensetsu vaults allow users to deposit XOR, VAL, or other assets to borrow KUSD.

terms.title: Vaults
terms.summary: Smart-contract containers that manage pooled assets. Vaults underpin planned Kensetsu money markets and Polkaswap liquidity programs.
terms.definition: Vaults automate strategies such as lending, liquidity provision, or reward distribution. In SORA, vaults will back Kensetsu stablecoins, manage collateral, and automate treasury deployments.

terms.title: Volatility
terms.summary: A measure of how widely an asset's price fluctuates over a period of time.
terms.definition: Volatility quantifies price dispersion using metrics such as standard deviation or implied volatility from derivatives markets. Higher volatility signals greater uncertainty and risk, influencing position sizing and hedging decisions for SORA participants.

terms.title: Voting
terms.summary: Voting is the act of citizens or stakeholders signaling support for SORA governance proposals through on-chain referenda or delegated councils.
terms.definition: Voting is the act of citizens or stakeholders signaling support for SORA governance proposals through on-chain referenda or delegated councils.
terms.tagline: Ensures democratic control over network evolution.

terms.title: VRF Aggregate
terms.summary: The combined verifiable random function output in SORA Nexus from validator committees, feeding epoch beacons and lane-specific randomness for fair leader selection.
terms.definition: The combined verifiable random function output in SORA Nexus from validator committees, feeding epoch beacons and lane-specific randomness for fair leader selection.
terms.tagline: Enables parallel transaction processing for higher throughput.

terms.title: VRF Sortition
terms.summary: A method in SORA Nexus for drawing validator committees where candidates prove via VRF that their random output meets a threshold, ensuring fair and unpredictable selection.
terms.definition: A method in SORA Nexus for drawing validator committees where candidates prove via VRF that their random output meets a threshold, ensuring fair and unpredictable selection.
terms.tagline: Prevents validator collusion by making committee selection unpredictable until the moment of reveal.

terms.title: Wallet
terms.summary: A wallet is the software that stores keys, signs transactions, and connects users to SORA DeFi apps such as Polkaswap, Fearless Wallet, or TONSwap.
terms.definition: A wallet is the software that stores keys, signs transactions, and connects users to SORA DeFi apps such as Polkaswap, Fearless Wallet, or TONSwap.
terms.tagline: Gateway to all SORA services and assets.

terms.title: WASM (WebAssembly)
terms.summary: A portable binary instruction format that enables high-performance smart contracts and runtime modules.
terms.definition: WebAssembly lets blockchain runtimes execute code securely and efficiently across platforms. SORA v3 / Hyperledger Iroha 3 executes on-ledger programmable logic as IVM bytecode (Kotodama) rather than general-purpose WASM modules. Many SORA ecosystem tools still compile to WASM for browser compatibility.

terms.title: Web3
terms.summary: The next iteration of the internet where decentralized protocols give users ownership over identity, assets, and coordination.
terms.definition: Web3 combines blockchain, decentralized storage, and smart contracts to deliver user-owned networks. SORA positions itself as a Web3 supranational economy that blends DeFi, governance, and real-world integrations.

terms.title: World State View (WSV)
terms.summary: The canonical state database in SORA Nexus holding current balances, metadata, and trigger definitions across all data spaces, providing every validator with a consistent snapshot of network state.
terms.definition: The canonical state database in SORA Nexus holding current balances, metadata, and trigger definitions across all data spaces, providing every validator with a consistent snapshot of network state.
terms.tagline: Gives every validator a consistent snapshot of network state, enabling instant balance queries.

terms.title: Xcm
terms.summary: Cross-Consensus Messaging - a messaging format that allows different consensus systems to communicate with each other. XCM enables interoperability between parachains in the Pol…
terms.definition: Cross-Consensus Messaging - a messaging format that allows different consensus systems to communicate with each other. XCM enables interoperability between parachains in the Polkadot ecosystem, allowing SORA to communicate with other parachains.

terms.title: Xcmp
terms.summary: Polkadot's Cross-Chain Message Passing protocol for parachain-to-parachain communication.
terms.definition: XCMP allows parachains to exchange messages directly while relying on the relay chain for ordering and security. It underpins trust-minimized asset transfers and remote calls, enabling SORA-aligned parachains to interoperate with the wider Polkadot ecosystem.

terms.title: XOR
terms.summary: The network utility token used for transaction fees (gas) where 50% of fees are burned and 50% go to validators. XOR has elastic supply managed by a token bonding curve and can …
terms.definition: The network utility token used for transaction fees (gas) where 50% of fees are burned and 50% go to validators. XOR has elastic supply managed by a token bonding curve and can be used for staking, liquidity provision, and future SORA Parliament membership.
terms.tagline: Powers every transaction on SORA and gives holders governance rights in the network.

terms.title: XOR Bonds
terms.summary: Stake deposits in XOR that governance proposals or data-space onboardings in SORA Nexus must lock, aligning economic incentives with network participation.
terms.definition: Stake deposits in XOR that governance proposals or data-space onboardings in SORA Nexus must lock, aligning economic incentives with network participation.
terms.tagline: Empowers the community to shape the network's evolution.

terms.title: XOR Fee Equilibrium
terms.summary: The economic model in SORA Nexus that balances lane demand, TEU costs, and fee floors to keep XOR rewards predictable and prevent fee volatility.
terms.definition: The economic model in SORA Nexus that balances lane demand, TEU costs, and fee floors to keep XOR rewards predictable and prevent fee volatility.
terms.tagline: Enables parallel transaction processing for higher throughput.

terms.title: XOR Utility
terms.summary: The multi-role nature of XOR in SORA Nexus serving as fee token, settlement asset, collateral for bonds, and governance voting power across all data spaces.
terms.definition: The multi-role nature of XOR in SORA Nexus serving as fee token, settlement asset, collateral for bonds, and governance voting power across all data spaces.
terms.tagline: Creates natural demand for XOR through its essential role in every network operation.

terms.title: XYK Pools
terms.summary: Constant Product Market Maker (CPMM) liquidity pools where the product of two token reserves remains constant (x * y = k). These are the primary liquidity pools on Polkaswap whe…
terms.definition: Constant Product Market Maker (CPMM) liquidity pools where the product of two token reserves remains constant (x * y = k). These are the primary liquidity pools on Polkaswap where users can provide liquidity and earn PSWAP rewards through yield farming.

terms.title: Yield Farming
terms.summary: A DeFi strategy where users provide liquidity to protocols and earn rewards. In Polkaswap, users can farm PSWAP tokens by providing liquidity to XYK pools, with rewards distribu…
terms.definition: A DeFi strategy where users provide liquidity to protocols and earn rewards. In Polkaswap, users can farm PSWAP tokens by providing liquidity to XYK pools, with rewards distributed through the platform's liquidity aggregation system. Polkaswap's unique infrastructure reduces impermanent loss risks while providing competitive yields through multi-source liquidity aggregation.

terms.title: ZK-Backed Access Tickets
terms.summary: Proof-carrying credentials in SORA Nexus that grant network access while cryptographically obscuring user identity and routing paths, enabling private participation.
terms.definition: Proof-carrying credentials in SORA Nexus that grant network access while cryptographically obscuring user identity and routing paths, enabling private participation.
terms.tagline: Grant network access while obscuring user identity or route.

terms.title: ZK DA Proofs
terms.summary: Zero-knowledge proofs that bind erasure-coded shards to block commitments, proving availability without revealing private data.
terms.definition: Zero-knowledge proofs that bind erasure-coded shards to block commitments, proving availability without revealing private data.
terms.tagline: Guarantees that transaction data remains accessible and verifiable.

terms.title: ZK-STARK vs. STARK
terms.summary: The Nexus clarification that FASTPQ can run in audit (non-zk) or privacy (zk) modes while sharing the same verifier logic.
terms.definition: The Nexus clarification that FASTPQ can run in audit (non-zk) or privacy (zk) modes while sharing the same verifier logic.
terms.tagline: FASTPQ can run in audit (non-zk) or privacy (zk) modes while sharing the same verifier logic.
